findings.title: New Aborted contention error is not handled on the add/update paths
findings.fix: In the WebApp, handle RpcException with StatusCode.Aborted on the add/update path: retry the update after re-fetching the basket (at least once), and if it still fails, show a non-crashing 'please try again' message instead of letting the exception escape to the error UI.
findings.routeWhy: flow finding about the production change
